in_hebrew.name: Skyler
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו A sky or heavenly scholar
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Skyler הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old English 'scylen' meaning 'scholar' or 'heavenly'. The name Skyler can be traced back to the Old Norse word 'skalr' which means 'shiny' or 'bright'. This name was popularized in the English-speaking world by the character Skyler White from the television series 'Breaking Bad'. In Christian tradition, the name Skyler holds symbolism of reaching for the heavens and striving for knowledge and wisdom.
